name: Cloudflare
author: mdick85
description: Cloudflare account resources, deployment status, usage meters, and dashboard token shortcuts in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Browse Workers, Pages, R2, D1, KV, Queues and zones; watch deployments; read usage against your plan limits; jump to the dashboard pages that mint API tokens.

schema.label: Resource refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the resource lists and deployment status are re-fetched.

schema.label: Analytics refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often the GraphQL usage query runs. Analytics lag by minutes, so a long interval costs nothing.

schema.label: Projects folder
schema.description: Scanned three levels deep for wrangler.toml/jsonc/json so deploy and rollback know where each Worker lives. Defaults to ~/Projects.

schema.label: Deployments on the overview
schema.description: The overview lists only the most recent few; open Workers or Pages for the rest.

schema.label: Worker requests/day allowance
schema.description: Denominator for the requests meter. 0 shows the raw count with no percentage; 100000 is the free plan.

schema.label: R2 storage allowance (GB)
schema.description: 0 shows the stored size with no percentage.

schema.label: D1 rows read/day allowance
schema.description: 0 shows the raw count with no percentage.

schema.label: Worker error rate warning (%)
schema.description: The bar icon shows a warning badge when any Worker's 24h error rate crosses this.
